- superpowers:receiving-code-review: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
- superpowers:requesting-code-review: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
- superpowers:subagent-driven-development: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
- superpowers:systematic-debugging: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

- superpowers:writing-skills: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
- andrej-karpathy-skills:karpathy-guidelines: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

- claude-in-chrome: Automates your Chrome browser to interact with web pages - clicking elements, filling forms, capturing screenshots, reading console logs, and navigating sites. Opens pages in new tabs within your existing Chrome session. Requires site-level permissions before executing (configured in the extension). - When the user wants to interact with web pages, automate browser tasks, capture screenshots, read console logs, or perform any browser-based actions. First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

177	在 `ies_auto_mibs.c`,於 `mox_snmp_init_entry` 函式**定義之前**(例如 line ~3232,函式上方)插入:
178	```c
179	#define AGENTX_OWNED_LIST_FILE   "/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list"
180	#define AGENTX_OWNED_MAX         (32)
181	#define AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN  (64)
182	static char gAgentXOwnedPrefix[AGENTX_OWNED_MAX][AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN];
183	static int  gAgentXOwnedCount  = 0;
184	static int  gAgentXOwnedLoaded = 0;
185	
186	static void mox_snmp_load_agentx_owned_list(void)
187	{
188	    FILE *fp;
189	    char  line[AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN];
190	
191	    gAgentXOwnedCount = 0;
192	    fp = fopen(AGENTX_OWNED_LIST_FILE, "r");
193	    if (fp == NULL) {
194	        return;                         /* legacy: no file → register everything locally */
195	    }
196	    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) != NULL &&
197	           gAgentXOwnedCount < AGENTX_OWNED_MAX) {
198	        char  *p = line;
199	        size_t n;
200	        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;          /* skip leading ws */
201	        if (*p == '#' || *p == '\n' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\0') continue;
202	        n = strlen(p);
203	        while (n > 0 && (p[n-1]=='\n'||p[n-1]=='\r'||p[n-1]==' '||p[n-1]=='\t'))
204	            p[--n] = '\0';                            /* strip trailing ws */
205	        if (n == 0) continue;
206	        strncpy(gAgentXOwnedPrefix[gAgentXOwnedCount], p, AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN-1);
207	        gAgentXOwnedPrefix[gAgentXOwnedCount][AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN-1] = '\0';
208	        gAgentXOwnedCount++;
209	    }
210	    fclose(fp);
211	}
212	
213	static int mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry)
214	{
215	    int i;
216	    if (entry->mode & HANDLER_CAN_SET) {
217	        return 0;                       /* RW → keep local; SET goes via framework */
218	    }
219	    for (i = 0; i < gAgentXOwnedCount; i++) {
220	        if (strncmp(entry->uri, gAgentXOwnedPrefix[i],
221	                    strlen(gAgentXOwnedPrefix[i])) == 0) {
222	            return 1;                   /* RO + prefix match → skip → ISS owns it */
223	        }
224	    }
225	    return 0;
226	}
227	```

- [ ] **Step 1: 加 reader + 判斷函式**

在 `ies_auto_mibs.c`,於 `mox_snmp_init_entry` 函式**定義之前**(例如 line ~3232,函式上方)插入:
```c
#define AGENTX_OWNED_LIST_FILE   "/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list"
#define AGENTX_OWNED_MAX         (32)
#define AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN  (64)
static char gAgentXOwnedPrefix[AGENTX_OWNED_MAX][AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN];
static int  gAgentXOwnedCount  = 0;
static int  gAgentXOwnedLoaded = 0;

static void mox_snmp_load_agentx_owned_list(void)
{
    FILE *fp;
    char  line[AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN];

    gAgentXOwnedCount = 0;
    fp = fopen(AGENTX_OWNED_LIST_FILE, "r");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        return;                         /* legacy: no file → register everything locally */
    }
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) != NULL &&
           gAgentXOwnedCount < AGENTX_OWNED_MAX) {
        char  *p = line;
        size_t n;
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;          /* skip leading ws */
        if (*p == '#' || *p == '\n' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\0') continue;
        n = strlen(p);
        while (n > 0 && (p[n-1]=='\n'||p[n-1]=='\r'||p[n-1]==' '||p[n-1]=='\t'))
            p[--n] = '\0';                            /* strip trailing ws */
        if (n == 0) continue;
        strncpy(gAgentXOwnedPrefix[gAgentXOwnedCount], p, AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN-1);
        gAgentXOwnedPrefix[gAgentXOwnedCount][AGENTX_OWNED_PREFIX_LEN-1] = '\0';
        gAgentXOwnedCount++;
    }
    fclose(fp);
}

static int mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry)
{
    int i;
    if (entry->mode & HANDLER_CAN_SET) {
        return 0;                       /* RW → keep local; SET goes via framework */
    }
    for (i = 0; i < gAgentXOwnedCount; i++) {
        if (strncmp(entry->uri, gAgentXOwnedPrefix[i],
                    strlen(gAgentXOwnedPrefix[i])) == 0) {
            return 1;                   /* RO + prefix match → skip → ISS owns it */
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
```

- **VRRP(68)的 badValue 是 ISS handler 的真 bug**,本設計只是「白名單不露它」→ walk 不再被截斷,但 bug 仍在。若未來要支援標準 VRRP-MIB,需另修 ISS handler(獨立工項/回報)。

```bash

# 2. top-level walk 完整(不被 VRRP 等截斷)
snmpwalk -v2c -c public <dut>            # 走完 mib-2 不報 badValue
snmpwalk -v2c -c public <dut> .1.3.6.1.4.1.8691   # 企業 MIB 可達

# 3. SET 仍走 framework、ISS 不上呼叫

So the PoC skip logic hasn't landed on this branch (matches your "我會手動拉到 agentx_owned.list 進度").

## Blockers I can't resolve from the code alone

**1. The GET/SET split mechanism.** You said *GET (RO+RW) → ISS, SET → legacy ies-auto-mibs*. But net-snmp's master routes by **OID region, not by PDU mode** — if I skip local registration, the ISS subagent wins *both* GET and SET for that OID. The original Plan C avoided this by skipping RO-only and keeping RW local. Your PoC apparently splits by GET-vs-SET mode instead, which I can't see because the skip code isn't merged here. I need that code to extend it correctly.

**2. Safety of delegating each DB.** Skipping local registration is only safe if the ISS subagent actually serves a getter for that OID tree. Per my notes (Plan D), no daemon serves OIDs directly — some go through config/status. Big-bang delegating all 1391 risks turning DBs ISS doesn't implement into `noSuchObject` regressions.

收到，我在這邊等你 build/pull 完成。以下是我對架構的理解確認（**兩軸正交設計**）：

## 我的理解

| 軸 | 機制 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **哪些 OID 走 AgentX** | `agentx_owned.list` → 建 **index table** | 命中者 skip 本地 `netsnmp_register_*`，讓 snmpd master 用 longest-prefix-match 路由出去。目前只有 `ifmibdb/` |
| **誰來服務** | `.iss_build` per-entry flag | `iss_build==1` → 送 **ISS**（1391 筆／~55 個 DB）；`iss_build==0`（745 筆）→ 之後另有用途，**先保留彈性**，不要寫死只給 ISS |

Base directory for this skill: /home/moxa/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.1.1/skills/brainstorming

# Brainstorming Ideas Into Designs

Help turn ideas into fully formed designs and specs through natural collaborative dialogue.

Start by understanding the current project context, then ask questions one at a time to refine the idea. Once you understand what you're building, present the design and get user approval.

<HARD-GATE>
Do NOT invoke any implementation skill, write any code, scaffold any project, or take any implementation action until you have presented a design and the user has approved it. This applies to EVERY project regardless of perceived simplicity.
</HARD-GATE>

## Anti-Pattern: "This Is Too Simple To Need A Design"

Every project goes through this process. A todo list, a single-function utility, a config change — all of them. "Simple" projects are where unexamined assumptions cause the most wasted work. The design can be short (a few sentences for truly simple projects), but you MUST present it and get approval.

## Checklist

You MUST create a task for each of these items and complete them in order:

1. **Explore project context** — check files, docs, recent commits
2. **Offer the visual companion just-in-time** — NOT upfront. The first time a question would genuinely be clearer shown than described, offer it then (its own message); on approval its browser tab opens for you. If no visual question ever arises, never offer it. See the Visual Companion section below.
3. **Ask clarifying questions** — one at a time, understand purpose/constraints/success criteria
4. **Propose 2-3 approaches** — with trade-offs and your recommendation
5. **Present design** — in sections scaled to their complexity, get user approval after each section
6. **Write design doc** — save to `docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md` and commit
7. **Spec self-review** — quick inline check for placeholders, contradictions, ambiguity, scope (see below)
8. **User reviews written spec** — ask user to review the spec file before proceeding
9. **Transition to implementation** — invoke writing-plans skill to create implementation plan

## Process Flow

```dot
digraph brainstorming {
    "Explore project context" [shape=box];
    "Ask clarifying questions" [shape=box];
    "Propose 2-3 approaches" [shape=box];
    "Present design sections" [shape=box];
    "User approves design?" [shape=diamond];
    "Write design doc" [shape=box];
    "Spec self-review\n(fix inline)" [shape=box];
    "User reviews spec?" [shape=diamond];
    "Invoke writing-plans skill" [shape=doublecircle];

    "Explore project context" -> "Ask clarifying questions";
    "Ask clarifying questions" -> "Propose 2-3 approaches";
    "Propose 2-3 approaches" -> "Present design sections";
    "Present design sections" -> "User approves design?";
    "User approves design?" -> "Present design sections" [label="no, revise"];
    "User approves design?" -> "Write design doc" [label="yes"];
    "Write design doc" -> "Spec self-review\n(fix inline)";
    "Spec self-review\n(fix inline)" -> "User reviews spec?";
    "User reviews spec?" -> "Write design doc" [label="changes requested"];
    "User reviews spec?" -> "Invoke writing-plans skill" [label="approved"];
}
```

**The terminal state is invoking writing-plans.** Do NOT invoke frontend-design, mcp-builder, or any other implementation skill. The ONLY skill you invoke after brainstorming is writing-plans.

## The Process

**Understanding the idea:**

- Check out the current project state first (files, docs, recent commits)
- Before asking detailed questions, assess scope: if the request describes multiple independent subsystems (e.g., "build a platform with chat, file storage, billing, and analytics"), flag this immediately. Don't spend questions refining details of a project that needs to be decomposed first.
- If the project is too large for a single spec, help the user decompose into sub-projects: what are the independent pieces, how do they relate, what order should they be built? Then brainstorm the first sub-project through the normal design flow. Each sub-project gets its own spec → plan → implementation cycle.
- For appropriately-scoped projects, ask questions one at a time to refine the idea
- Prefer multiple choice questions when possible, but open-ended is fine too
- Only one question per message - if a topic needs more exploration, break it into multiple questions
- Focus on understanding: purpose, constraints, success criteria

**Exploring approaches:**

- Propose 2-3 different approaches with trade-offs
- Present options conversationally with your recommendation and reasoning
- Lead with your recommended option and explain why

**Presenting the design:**

- Once you believe you understand what you're building, present the design
- Scale each section to its complexity: a few sentences if straightforward, up to 200-300 words if nuanced
- Ask after each section whether it looks right so far
- Cover: architecture, components, data flow, error handling, testing
- Be ready to go back and clarify if something doesn't make sense

**Design for isolation and clarity:**

- Break the system into smaller units that each have one clear purpose, communicate through well-defined interfaces, and can be understood and tested independently
- For each unit, you should be able to answer: what does it do, how do you use it, and what does it depend on?
- Can someone understand what a unit does without reading its internals? Can you change the internals without breaking consumers? If not, the boundaries need work.
- Smaller, well-bounded units are also easier for you to work with - you reason better about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. When a file grows large, that's often a signal that it's doing too much.

**Working in existing codebases:**

- Explore the current structure before proposing changes. Follow existing patterns.
- Where existing code has problems that affect the work (e.g., a file that's grown too large, unclear boundaries, tangled responsibilities), include targeted improvements as part of the design - the way a good developer improves code they're working in.
- Don't propose unrelated refactoring. Stay focused on what serves the current goal.

## After the Design

**Documentation:**

- Write the validated design (spec) to `docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md`
  - (User preferences for spec location override this default)
- Use elements-of-style:writing-clearly-and-concisely skill if available
- Commit the design document to git

**Spec Self-Review:**
After writing the spec document, look at it with fresh eyes:

1. **Placeholder scan:** Any "TBD", "TODO", incomplete sections, or vague requirements? Fix them.
2. **Internal consistency:** Do any sections contradict each other? Does the architecture match the feature descriptions?
3. **Scope check:** Is this focused enough for a single implementation plan, or does it need decomposition?
4. **Ambiguity check:** Could any requirement be interpreted two different ways? If so, pick one and make it explicit.

Fix any issues inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on.

**User Review Gate:**
After the spec review loop passes, ask the user to review the written spec before proceeding:

> "Spec written and committed to `<path>`. Please review it and let me know if you want to make any changes before we start writing out the implementation plan."

Wait for the user's response. If they request changes, make them and re-run the spec review loop. Only proceed once the user approves.

**Implementation:**

- Invoke the writing-plans skill to create a detailed implementation plan
- Do NOT invoke any other skill. writing-plans is the next step.

## Key Principles

- **One question at a time** - Don't overwhelm with multiple questions
- **Multiple choice preferred** - Easier to answer than open-ended when possible
- **YAGNI ruthlessly** - Remove unnecessary features from all designs
- **Explore alternatives** - Always propose 2-3 approaches before settling
- **Incremental validation** - Present design, get approval before moving on
- **Be flexible** - Go back and clarify when something doesn't make sense

## Visual Companion

A browser-based companion for showing mockups, diagrams, and visual options during brainstorming. Available as a tool — not a mode. Accepting the companion means it's available for questions that benefit from visual treatment; it does NOT mean every question goes through the browser.

**Offering the companion (just-in-time):** Do NOT offer it upfront. Wait until a question would genuinely be clearer shown than told — a real mockup / layout / diagram question, not merely a UI *topic*. The first time that happens, offer it then, as its own message:
> "This next part might be easier if I show you — I can put together mockups, diagrams, and comparisons in a browser tab as we go. It's still new and can be token-intensive. Want me to? I'll open it for you."

**This offer MUST be its own message.** Only the offer — no clarifying question, summary, or other content. Wait for the user's response. If they accept, start the server with `--open` so their browser opens to the first screen automatically. If they decline, continue text-only and don't offer again unless they raise it.

**Per-question decision:** Even after the user accepts, decide FOR EACH QUESTION whether to use the browser or the terminal. The test: **would the user understand this better by seeing it than reading it?**

- **Use the browser** for content that IS visual — mockups, wireframes, layout comparisons, architecture diagrams, side-by-side visual designs
- **Use the terminal** for content that is text — requirements questions, conceptual choices, tradeoff lists, A/B/C/D text options, scope decisions

A question about a UI topic is not automatically a visual question. "What does personality mean in this context?" is a conceptual question — use the terminal. "Which wizard layout works better?" is a visual question — use the browser.

If they agree to the companion, read the detailed guide before proceeding:
`skills/brainstorming/visual-companion.md`

# ADR-0001: mxTrap RowStatus via IES_COL_ROWSTATUS on framework AgentX

Status: Accepted
Date: 2026-07-22
Context:
  Plan D migrates iss_build==0 MIB groups from snmpd in-master (ies-auto-mibs)
  to app_moxa_framework AgentX subagent by reusing net_*.h in
  lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs mapping_reuse.c. net_mx_trap_notification.h
  (mxTrap_MibEntry) includes a host table with SNMP RowStatus. In-master
  handles that via IES_FLAG_SNMP_READ_CREATE_v2 and
  readCreate_uri_set_tableRowStatus_v2 (config stores host[] with a `valid`
  boolean, not a rowStatus field). The framework handler only understood
  IES_COL_SCALAR / ROW_INDEX / PBMP_VALUE / IDXTBL_* / TR2RING_VALUE; treating
  rowStatus as IDXTBL_VALUE would wrongly SET snmpTrap/host/N/rowStatus.
  We need a reusable column class for RowStatus so later groups
  (trustAccess, IpIfdb, …) can share the same path, while migrating mxTrap
  fully (scalars + host table + RowStatus) closest to in-master behavior.
Decision:
  1. Add IES_COL_ROWSTATUS (and Rust col::ROWSTATUS) for reuse classification.
  2. Migrate mxTrap_MibEntry into g_reuse_srcs; register host rows with
     product max 2 (schema maxItems); mark uri_index=="rowStatus" as
     IES_COL_ROWSTATUS.
  3. Implement RowStatus GET/SET in app_moxa_framework snmp_subagent.rs:
     GET maps host[N].valid -> active(1)/notInService(2); SET active /
     notInService / createAndGo / createAndWait / destroy mutates
     snmpTrap/host[] (whole-array PATCH), mirroring in-master valid semantics.
  4. Comment out MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY(mxTrap_MibEntry) in 3rdparty_net_snmp
     so only the framework subagent owns these OIDs.
Alternatives Considered:
  - Stage A only (skip rowStatus): smaller diff, but leaves create/destroy on
    in-master or broken; does not clear the "RowStatus(架構)" migrate blocker.
  - String-special-case uri_index=="rowStatus" in the handler without a new
    IES_COL_*: fewer files touched, but breaks the existing table_col reuse
    pattern and complicates the next RowStatus tables.
  - Port the full ies-auto-mibs Read-Create v2 engine into lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs:
    closest byte-copy, far too large and wrong layer (lib is mapping + classify).
Consequences:
  - Framework owns mxTrap config OIDs; dual registration must be avoided.
  - RowStatus semantics are reimplemented in Rust (not the C v2 engine); edge
    cases (sparse OID index vs append) must stay aligned with product tests.
  - Future RowStatus tables should reuse IES_COL_ROWSTATUS + extend the
    handler rather than inventing per-MIB flags in mapping_reuse.
  - Rebuild order: lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs → lib_moxa_rust_ies_auto_mibs →
    app_moxa_framework and 3rdparty_net_snmp together.
Constraints / Assumptions:
  - snmpTrap.host maxItems == 2 (plugin_moxa_snmp config schema).
  - Config JSON has no rowStatus key; life-cycle maps through `valid`.
  - SNMP RowStatus integers: 1=active, 2=notInService, 4=createAndGo,
    5=createAndWait, 6=destroy (same as MOXA_SNMP_READ_CREATE_*).
Related Files / Modules:
  - lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/include/lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs.h
  - lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/src/mapping_reuse.c
  - lib_moxa_rust_ies_auto_mibs/src/lib.rs
  - app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs
  - 3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup.c
  - 3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/net_mx_trap_notification.h
  - 3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_handle_read_create_v2_mxTrap_host.c
  - plugin_moxa_snmp/framework/src/config_snmp_trap.rs
Related ADRs:
  - ADR-0002 (ies-auto-mibs 資料/引擎分層;本 ADR 的 valid-toggle 是其「重實作」手法的實例)

1	# ADR-0002: ies-auto-mibs 分層 —— 對映資料可拆為 shared lib,net-snmp agent 角色不可拆
2	
3	Status: Accepted
4	Date: 2026-07-22
5	Context:
6	  Plan D 把 iss_build==0 的 config MIB 群組從 snmpd in-master(ies-auto-mibs)
7	  遷到 app_moxa_framework 的 AgentX subagent。過程中反覆出現一個架構問題:
8	  ies-auto-mibs 能不能離開 3rdparty_net_snmp、獨立成一個不依賴 net-snmp 的
9	  shared library?兩個發現逼出結論:
10	  (1) RowStatus:framework subagent 用 netsnmp_register_instance(每個 OID 一個
11	      instance),一個 createAndGo 的 SET PDU 多個 varbind 會被 net-snmp 各自
12	      路由到自己的 handler,rowStatus handler 看不到同列的其他欄位 → 動態
13	      append 表無法原子建列。in-master 靠 net-snmp 的 table 註冊 +
14	      readCreate_uri_set_tableRowStatus_v2 + 多階段 SET 才做得到。
15	  (2) 「所有 iss0 SNMP GET 都走 AgentX 到 framework」這個需求,
16	      lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 自己辦不到 —— 它連向 master 註冊一個 OID 都不做。
17	Decision:
18	  把 ies-auto-mibs 視為兩層,分別處置:
19	  1. 對映 DATA + 分類層(net_*.h 的 OID↔URI 陣列、table_col 分類):
20	     不依賴 net-snmp,可獨立、且已獨立成 lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs,由 subagent 重用。
21	  2. net-snmp HANDLER 引擎(mox_snmp_handle_entry 的 GET/SET 分派、
22	     readCreate_uri_set_tableRowStatus_v2 + table 註冊 + RESERVE/ACTION/COMMIT
23	     多階段 SET):與 net-snmp 不可分 —— 它的存在目的就是「當一個 net-snmp
24	     MIB module」。不抽出。
25	  Plan D 不「抽出」引擎,而是在 app_moxa_framework 內「重實作」值語意:
26	  GET 走 in-process config 讀、SET 走 REST PATCH、RowStatus 走 valid-toggle
27	  (見 ADR-0001)。服務 SNMP GET 本質上一定活在某個 net-snmp agent(in-master
28	  snmpd 或 AgentX subagent);lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 必要但不充分,無法自行
29	  註冊/路由/服務。「iss0 GET 全走 framework」需三方協作:
30	  lib(資料)+ app_moxa_framework/lib_moxa_snmp_agentx(AgentX 註冊 + handler)
31	  + 3rdparty_net_snmp(註解 INIT_ENTRY 讓出 OID 擁有權)。
32	Alternatives Considered:
33	  - 把整個 ies-auto-mibs(資料 + handler 引擎)抽成不依賴 net-snmp 的 lib:
34	    不可行 —— 引擎的本質就是 net-snmp agent module,RowStatus read_create 依賴
35	    net-snmp 的 table 註冊與 SET 階段;硬抽等於把 net-snmp 一起拖走,或重寫
36	    net-snmp 的 agent 核心。
37	  - 全部留 in-master(不做 lib):放棄了 Plan D 追求的 in-process GET 效率與
38	    可追溯性(先前已否決)。
39	  - 讓 lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 自己註冊/服務 OID:層次錯誤 —— 它會因此依賴
40	    net-snmp/AgentX,失去「純資料契約」的意義,並與 subagent 重複。
41	Consequences:
42	  - lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 維持純資料/分類(無 net-snmp、無註冊、無 I/O),
43	    應持續守住這條界線。
44	  - AgentX 註冊 + GET/SET handler 由 framework subagent 負責;
45	    3rdparty_net_snmp 的 INIT_ENTRY 註解是擁有權交接點。
46	  - RowStatus 等 net-snmp 耦合語意是「重實作」非「移植」,每一張表都要對產品
47	    行為驗證。
48	  - 殘留的硬邊界:動態長度陣列上、需同 PDU 原子性多欄建列(append 式
49	    createAndGo)是 per-instance subagent 唯一複製不了的情境。lifecycle 為固定槽
50	    `valid` toggle 的表(trap,或 trustAccess 待驗)可行;真正動態的表
51	    (ipIfdb l3VlanIfTable,VLAN 動態長度)可能撞到天花板,遷移前先驗 lifecycle。
52	  - 因此部分 iss0 群組刻意留 in-master(dynamic RowStatus、runtime/command 資料
53	    來源、產品未編入)—— Plan D 的覆蓋是有界的,不是全量。
54	Constraints / Assumptions:
55	  - framework subagent 用 netsnmp_register_instance(逐 OID instance),非 table
56	    註冊(lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c)。
57	  - iss_build==0 = framework/config 擁有;iss_build==1 = ISS 擁有(不變)。
58	  - RowStatus 表的 config lifecycle 是 running_config 內每列一個 `valid` boolean,
59	    而非 MIB 的 rowStatus 欄。
60	Related Files / Modules:
61	  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/ (資料 + 分類;src/mapping_reuse.c,
62	    include/lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs.h)
63	  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_rust_ies_auto_mibs/src/lib.rs (FFI mirror)
64	  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c (netsnmp_register_instance)
65	  - buildroot/dl/app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs (註冊 + GET/SET handler)
66	  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup.c (INIT_ENTRY 交接)
67	  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_handle_read_create_v2_*.c
68	    (net-snmp 綁定的 RowStatus 引擎,示範不可拆的那一層)
69	Related ADRs:
70	  - ADR-0001 (mxTrap RowStatus via IES_COL_ROWSTATUS —— 本 ADR 概念化的「重實作」手法)
71

     多階段 SET):與 net-snmp 不可分 —— 它的存在目的就是「當一個 net-snmp
     MIB module」。不抽出。
  Plan D 不「抽出」引擎,而是在 app_moxa_framework 內「重實作」值語意:
  GET 走 in-process config 讀、SET 走 REST PATCH、RowStatus 走 valid-toggle
  (見 ADR-0001)。服務 SNMP GET 本質上一定活在某個 net-snmp agent(in-master
  snmpd 或 AgentX subagent);lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 必要但不充分,無法自行
  註冊/路由/服務。「iss0 GET 全走 framework」需三方協作:
  lib(資料)+ app_moxa_framework/lib_moxa_snmp_agentx(AgentX 註冊 + handler)
  + 3rdparty_net_snmp(註解 INIT_ENTRY 讓出 OID 擁有權)。
Alternatives Considered:
  - 把整個 ies-auto-mibs(資料 + handler 引擎)抽成不依賴 net-snmp 的 lib:
    不可行 —— 引擎的本質就是 net-snmp agent module,RowStatus read_create 依賴
    net-snmp 的 table 註冊與 SET 階段;硬抽等於把 net-snmp 一起拖走,或重寫
    net-snmp 的 agent 核心。

    可追溯性(先前已否決)。
  - 讓 lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 自己註冊/服務 OID:層次錯誤 —— 它會因此依賴
    net-snmp/AgentX,失去「純資料契約」的意義,並與 subagent 重複。
Consequences:
  - lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 維持純資料/分類(無 net-snmp、無註冊、無 I/O),
    應持續守住這條界線。
  - AgentX 註冊 + GET/SET handler 由 framework subagent 負責;
    3rdparty_net_snmp 的 INIT_ENTRY 註解是擁有權交接點。
  - RowStatus 等 net-snmp 耦合語意是「重實作」非「移植」,每一張表都要對產品
    行為驗證。
  - 殘留的硬邊界:動態長度陣列上、需同 PDU 原子性多欄建列(append 式
    createAndGo)是 per-instance subagent 唯一複製不了的情境。lifecycle 為固定槽

  - 因此部分 iss0 群組刻意留 in-master(dynamic RowStatus、runtime/command 資料
    來源、產品未編入)—— Plan D 的覆蓋是有界的,不是全量。
Constraints / Assumptions:
  - framework subagent 用 netsnmp_register_instance(逐 OID instance),非 table
    註冊(lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c)。
  - iss_build==0 = framework/config 擁有;iss_build==1 = ISS 擁有(不變)。
  - RowStatus 表的 config lifecycle 是 running_config 內每列一個 `valid` boolean,
    而非 MIB 的 rowStatus 欄。

content.text:
I now have an accurate picture. Let me present my evaluation.

## 評估：Plan E（iss_build==0 GET 前送 framework、SET 留 in-master）

先確認我讀到的**現況**（比 plan 文件新很多）：

- **Plan C 已演化**成不是「skip 註冊讓 master 路由」，而是**在 handler 內前送**：`mox_snmp_handle_entry` 的 `MODE_IS_GET` 分支（`ies_auto_mibs.c:3238-3250`）呼叫 `mox_snmp_entry_iss_get_forward_rule()` → `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss()`。RW 欄位**仍在本地註冊**（SET 留本地），只把 GET 用 probe OID + `netsnmp_subtree_find` + `netsnmp_call_handlers` 手動轉到 ISS AgentX subagent。
- 這條分支目前的 iss_build==0 GET 走的是**慢的 REST 路徑**（`entry_handle_generate_uri_value_file`，註解寫 ~600ms）。
- Plan D 的 INIT_ENTRY 交接**不在這條 branch 上**（你說 Plan D 已 rebase 到 mainline/develop）。framework subagent 用 `netsnmp_register_instance`（逐 OID instance）—— `lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c:60`，符合 ADR-0002。

### Plan E 的本質：Plan C 的鏡像 + 直接繞過 ADR-0002 的硬邊界

你的想法其實非常對稱、也很聰明：

| | 走誰服務 GET | SET 留哪 | 機制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Plan C**（iss_build==1） | ISS AgentX subagent（快） | 本地/framework | handler 內 probe→forward GET |
| **Plan E**（iss_build==0） | framework AgentX subagent（快） | **in-master** | 同一套 probe→forward GET |

**最強的一點**：ADR-0001/0002 記錄的死結是 —— framework 用 per-instance `netsnmp_register_instance`，一個 createAndGo 的多 varbind SET PDU 會被逐欄路由，rowStatus handler 看不到同列其他欄 → **動態 append 表無法原子建列**。Plan E 把 SET 留 in-master（net-snmp table 註冊 + `readCreate_v2` 多階段 SET 本來就能原子處理 rowStatus），**只前送 GET**。這等於直接避開 ADR-0002 標的「殘留硬邊界」，而不是硬去 Rust 重實作 valid-toggle。這一點我認為方向正確。

### 但有一個必須攤開的架構衝突（ADR skill 要求我 flag）

Plan E 要能「前送 GET 到 framework」，framework subagent **必須也註冊那些 iss_build==0 OID**（否則 `netsnmp_subtree_find(probe)` 找不到目標 reginfo）。但同時你要 SET 留 in-master → in-master **也**得保留註冊。這就是 **dual registration**，而 **ADR-0001 Consequences 明寫「dual registration must be avoided」、ADR-0002 的 Plan D 決策是「註解掉 INIT_ENTRY 讓 framework 獨佔」**。

Plan E 要的正好相反：**保留 INIT_ENTRY（in-master 擁有、贏得 wire 請求並處理 SET）+ framework 併存註冊（僅當 GET 前送標的）**。這跟 Plan C 對 ISS 做的完全同型（in-master 贏 wire、手動把 GET 轉給另一個 subagent），技術上可行，但它**牴觸 ADR-0001/0002 的擁有權模型**。依 ADR skill，這需要一個**新 ADR 來 supersede（或明確界定 Plan D 覆蓋範圍）**，不能默默違反。

一個自然的收斂：ADR-0002 本來就承認「部分 iss0 群組**刻意留 in-master**（dynamic RowStatus…）—— Plan D 覆蓋是有界的」。**Plan E 剛好就是那個「留 in-master」子集的具體機制**，而且額外幫這些留守群組把慢 GET（REST）換成快 GET（framework AgentX 前送）。這樣 Plan D / Plan E 不是取代關係，而是 iss_build==0 的**兩種處置分工**。

在寫任何 code 或展開 plan 前，這個 scope 決策決定了整個設計走向：

content.text:
兩個決策都收到了，而且都指向同一個結論：**Plan E 是全 iss_build==0 的通用政策，會 supersede Plan D 在 ADR-0001/0002 裡「SET→framework + 註解 INIT_ENTRY 交接擁有權」的決策**。這是重大架構變更，我會依 ADR 規範處理（新開 ADR、把舊的標 Superseded，但**動舊 ADR 前會先問你**）。

先把設計攤開讓你確認。我在準備過程中發現一個關鍵技術點，會影響機制設計，一併說明。

---

## Plan E 設計草案

### 1. 擁有權模型（supersede 什麼、保留什麼）

| 面向 | Plan D（ADR-0001/0002） | **Plan E（新）** |
|---|---|---|
| iss_build==0 OID wire 擁有 | framework 獨佔（註解 INIT_ENTRY） | **in-master 保留註冊、贏 wire** |
| SET | framework Rust subagent（valid-toggle 重實作 rowStatus） | **in-master `readCreate_v2` 多階段 SET**（原子建列不變） |
| GET | framework AgentX（快） | **in-master 前送 → framework AgentX（快）** |
| dual registration | 明令避免 | **刻意併存**（in-master 贏 wire+SET，framework 服務被前送的 GET） |

- **Supersede**：ADR-0001 決策 #3(#4)、ADR-0002 的「SET→framework / INIT_ENTRY 交接 / 避免 dual registration」。
- **保留**：ADR-0002 的資料層決策（`lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` = 純資料/分類，無 net-snmp）完全不變 —— framework subagent 仍重用它。
- **最大收益**：rowStatus 原子性留在 in-master 本來就會的地方，不必在 Rust 重實作 valid-toggle，直接消掉 ADR-0002 的「殘留硬邊界」。

### 2. GET 前送機制（我建議比 Plan C 更通用的做法）

Plan C 現在用**硬寫的 probe 規則表**（`mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]` 4 條），因為那些 RW 欄 ISS 沒註冊，得靠 probe 到 ISS 領土的 RO OID 定位 reginfo。

但 Plan E 是**同一顆 OID 由 in-master 與 framework 併存註冊**，所以不需要 probe。可以直接：

> `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework(entry, …)`：用 `netsnmp_subtree_find`/`_find_next` 在該 OID 上**迭代 subtree，挑出 reginfo->handler 不是自己（`mox_snmp_handle_entry`）的那個**（＝framework AgentX 註冊），前送過去。用 `moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri(entry)`（iss_build==0）當閘門。

這樣就是**按 flag 通用**，不用為 745 個 iss_build==0 entry / ~30 群組手寫 probe。這是讓「全 iss_build==0」可行的關鍵。

### 3. 我必須誠實標的兩個技術風險（決定成敗）

1. **net-snmp 對「同 OID 重複註冊」的處理**：net-snmp 允許同 region 多個 subtree **但要靠不同 priority 排序**（AgentX override 就靠這個）。所以 **in-master 與 framework 必須設不同 priority，且 in-master priority 要較高（贏 wire，才能攔 SET 與轉 GET）**。若 priority 沒設好，可能被判 `DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION` 拒絕，或 wire 請求跑錯 agent。這需要一個 PoC 先驗。
2. **framework 必須註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID**（否則前送找不到目標）—— 這是 framework subagent 側的工作量，且跟 Plan D「只挑能乾淨遷移的群組」不同，Plan E 要求**全註冊為 GET 服務端**。

### 4. 驗證準則（PoC 先打通再全推）

- 取一個有 rowStatus 的 iss_build==0 群組（如 trustAccess 或 mxTrap）：
  - `snmpset` createAndGo/destroy → 由 in-master 原子完成、config 正確。
  - `snmpget/walk` 該群組 → DUT 端 framework subagent 統計增加（GET 確實前送）、延遲從 ~600ms 降到 AgentX 量級。
  - `netsnmp_subtree_find` 能同時看到兩個註冊、priority 正確、wire SET 落 in-master。

---

在我寫 spec + 新 ADR 之前，請你確認/修正這個設計形狀。特別是 **§2 我建議用「迭代 subtree 挑非自身 handler」取代硬寫 probe 表**、以及 **§3 的 priority 風險要先做 PoC** —— 這兩點你認同嗎？還是有你已知的限制我該納入？

# Plan E — iss_build==0：SNMP GET 前送 framework AgentX、SET 留 in-master

> Design decision date: 2026-07-23
> Supersedes(擁有權/SET 面向): Plan D 於 ADR-0001 / ADR-0002 的「iss_build==0 SET→framework、
> 註解 INIT_ENTRY 交接擁有權、避免 dual registration」決策。
> 保留: ADR-0002 的資料層決策(`lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` = 純資料/分類,無 net-snmp)。
> Builds on: Plan C 已上線的「handler 內前送 GET」機制(`mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss`)。
> Codebase: `~/mds4xgl3/buildroot/dl`;branch `2023.02.11_develop`。

---

## 1. 目標與範圍

**目標**:讓 `iss_build==0`(framework/config 擁有)的 MIB 群組
- **SNMP GET / walk 加速**:由 in-master 前送到 app_moxa_framework 的 AgentX subagent(in-process config 讀,取代目前 `entry_handle_generate_uri_value_file` 的 REST 慢路徑 ~600ms)。
- **一致性**:GET 由 config source-of-truth(framework)回答。
- **SNMP SET 正確性**:留在 in-master(`readCreate_v2` + net-snmp table 註冊 + RESERVE/ACTION/COMMIT 多階段),rowStatus 原子建列不變 —— 不在 framework 的 per-instance 模型重實作。

**通用政策**:適用**全部** `iss_build==0`,不是只挑子集。這點與 Plan D(只遷能乾淨遷移的群組、SET 也搬到 framework)不同,並取代 Plan D 的 SET 遷移方向。

**不在範圍**:
- `iss_build==1`(ISS 擁有)維持 Plan C(`agentx_owned.list` + 前送 ISS AgentX)。本設計不動。
- `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` 的資料/分類角色不變。

**成功準則**:
- 對 `iss_build==0` 群組 `snmpwalk`:值正確、延遲降到 AgentX 量級、DUT 端 framework subagent 的 Rx Get/GetNext 統計隨之增加。
- `snmpset`(含 createAndGo/destroy 的 rowStatus 表)由 in-master 原子完成、config 正確。
- wire 上的 SET 落 in-master(不是 framework);GET 被 in-master 攔截後前送 framework。

---

## 2. 為什麼這樣分(對照 Plan C / Plan D)

| | GET 走誰(快) | SET 留哪 | 機制 | 動 rowStatus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plan C(iss_build==1) | ISS AgentX subagent | 本地/framework | handler 內 probe→forward | 不需 |
| Plan D(iss_build==0) | framework AgentX | framework(Rust valid-toggle) | 註解 INIT_ENTRY 交接擁有權 | **Rust 重實作** |
| **Plan E(iss_build==0)** | framework AgentX | **in-master** | handler 內 forward GET | **in-master 原生,不重實作** |

**關鍵理由(ADR-0002 記錄的硬邊界)**:framework subagent 用 `netsnmp_register_instance`(逐 OID instance),一個 createAndGo 的多 varbind SET PDU 會被逐欄路由,rowStatus handler 看不到同列其他欄 → **動態 append 表無法原子建列**。in-master 靠 net-snmp table 註冊 + `readCreate_uri_set_tableRowStatus_v2` + 多階段 SET 本來就能做到。

Plan E 把 SET 留 in-master、只前送 GET,**直接繞過**這個邊界,不必逐表在 Rust 重實作 valid-toggle 語意並對產品行為逐一驗證(ADR-0001/0002 的持續成本)。這是 Plan C「in-master 贏 wire、只把 GET 轉給另一個 subagent」模式的鏡像。

---

## 3. 架構與資料流

```
              wire (snmpd master)
                    │
   ┌────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────┐
   │ in-master (ies-auto-mibs dlmod) 保留註冊、priority 較高 │
   │  mox_snmp_handle_entry:                                │
   │   MODE_IS_GET  + iss_build==0  → forward_get_to_framework ──┐
   │   MODE_IS_GET  + iss_build==1  → forward_get_to_iss (Plan C) │
   │   MODE_IS_SET                  → in-master readCreate_v2 (原子) │
   └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
                                                                 ▼
                                    app_moxa_framework AgentX subagent
                                    (併存註冊同 OID,in-process config 讀,快)
```

- **GET(iss_build==0)**:wire 請求落 in-master(priority 贏)→ handler 判 `moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri(entry)` 命中 → `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework()` 找到 framework 的 reginfo → `netsnmp_call_handlers` 前送 → framework in-process 回值。
- **SET(iss_build==0)**:wire 請求落 in-master → 既有 `MODE_IS_SET` 路徑(`moxaSnmpHandle_*SetValue` / `mox_snmp_flask_handle_entry_set` / readCreate_v2)。**完全不改**。
- **dual registration**:in-master 與 framework 併存註冊同 OID,靠 **priority** 排序:in-master priority 較高 → 贏 wire(攔 SET、攔 GET 再轉);framework 作為被前送的 GET 服務端。

---

## 4. 組件改動

### 4.1 in-master handler(核心,`3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c`)

在 `mox_snmp_handle_entry` 的 `MODE_IS_GET` 分支(現行 `ies_auto_mibs.c:3233`,Plan C ISS 前送區塊 3238-3250 之後)新增 iss_build==0 前送:

```c
if ( moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri(entry) )   /* iss_build==0 */
{
    if ( mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework(entry, reqinfo, request) == 0 )
    {
        return SNMP_ERR_NOERROR;
    }
    /* framework subagent 未連 → fall through 到既有 REST 慢路徑 */
}
```

新增 `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework()`:**不用硬寫 probe 表**(有別於 Plan C 的 `mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]`)。因為 Plan E 同顆 OID 由 in-master 與 framework 併存註冊,可直接在該 OID 上迭代 subtree,挑出 `reginfo->handler` **不是自身 `mox_snmp_handle_entry`** 的那個(＝framework AgentX 註冊),前送過去:

```c
static int
mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry,
                                  netsnmp_agent_request_info *reqinfo,
                                  netsnmp_request_info       *request)
{
    netsnmp_subtree *sub = netsnmp_subtree_find(entry->oid_list, entry->oid_len,
                                                NULL, NULL);
    /* 迭代同 OID 的多個 subtree(dual registration 依 priority 排),
       跳過自身 handler,找到 framework AgentX 的 reginfo */
    while ( sub != NULL )
    {
        if ( sub->reginfo && sub->reginfo->handler &&
             sub->reginfo->handler->access_method != mox_snmp_handle_entry )
        {
            netsnmp_request_info *saved_next = request->next;
            request->next = NULL;
            (void) netsnmp_call_handlers(sub->reginfo, reqinfo, request);
            request->next = saved_next;
            return 0;
        }
        sub = sub->next;   /* 或 netsnmp_subtree_find_next,依 net-snmp 版本 API */
    }
    return -1;             /* framework 未註冊/未連 → caller fallback */
}
```

> 迭代 API 的正確形式(`sub->next` vs `netsnmp_subtree_find_next` vs 遍歷 registration list)於 PoC(§6)以 net-snmp 5.9.3 source 核實後定案。

### 4.2 framework AgentX subagent(`app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs`、`lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c`)

- **註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID** 為 GET 服務端(目前 `netsnmp_register_instance`,`agentx.c:60`)。與 Plan D 不同:Plan D 只挑能乾淨遷移的群組;Plan E 要求全註冊(否則前送找不到目標)。
- **只需服務 GET**:SET 由 in-master 處理,framework 端不需正確處理 rowStatus SET(可拒/忽略 SET,因 wire SET 不會落到它)。
- 註冊 **priority 需低於 in-master**(數值較大),使 in-master 贏 wire。確切值於 PoC 定。

### 4.3 INIT_ENTRY / 擁有權(`ies_auto_mibs_setup.c`)

- **保留** iss_build==0 的 `MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY(...)`(in-master 續持有,贏 wire、處理 SET)。
- 若 Plan D 分支上已註解掉某些群組(如 mxTrap)的 INIT_ENTRY → Plan E 需**還原**(讓 in-master 重新持有 SET)。這是 supersede ADR-0001 #4 的具體動作。

### 4.4 agentx_owned.list

- 維持現狀(governs iss_build==1 → ISS)。Plan E **不**依賴它:iss_build==0 前送靠 flag + subtree 迭代,不靠 list。

---

## 5. Supersede 對照(依 ADR 規範)

| ADR 決策 | 狀態 | Plan E 取代為 |
|---|---|---|
| ADR-0001 #3:createAndGo/destroy 在 Rust snmp_subagent | Superseded(擁有權面) | SET 留 in-master readCreate_v2 |
| ADR-0001 #4:註解 INIT_ENTRY 讓 framework 獨佔 | Superseded | 保留 INIT_ENTRY,in-master 持有;framework 併存僅服務 GET |
| ADR-0002:「iss0 SET→framework」「INIT_ENTRY 交接」「避免 dual registration」 | Superseded(擁有權面) | in-master 持有 SET;刻意 dual registration(priority 分序) |
| ADR-0002:`lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` = 純資料/分類 | **保留** | 不變,framework subagent 續重用 |

→ 產出 **ADR-0003(Proposed)**;PoC(§6)通過並全推後轉 Accepted,屆時把 ADR-0001/0002 狀態改 `Superseded by ADR-0003`(**動舊 ADR 前先與 user 確認**)。

---

## 6. 尚未驗證的技術風險(PoC 先打通再全推)

1. **net-snmp 同 OID 重複註冊**:net-snmp 允許同 region 多 subtree,但靠 **priority** 排序;需驗
   - in-master 與 framework 用不同 priority、in-master 較高時,兩個 registration **都存在且可被 `netsnmp_subtree_find*` 迭代到**(而非第二個被判 `MIB_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION` 拒絕)。
   - wire GET/SET 確實落 in-master(priority 贏)。
2. **subtree 迭代 API**:`mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework` 迭代同 OID 多 subtree 並辨識「非自身 handler」的正確 net-snmp 5.9.3 API 形式。
3. **framework 全註冊成本**:framework subagent 註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID 為 GET 服務端(僅 GET);記憶體/啟動時間影響評估。

**PoC 對象**:取一個有 rowStatus 的 iss_build==0 群組(建議 trustAccess 或 mxTrap):
- `snmpset` createAndGo/destroy → in-master 原子完成、config 正確、wire 落 in-master。
- `snmpget/walk` → framework subagent 統計增加、延遲降到 AgentX 量級。
- gdb/log 驗 `netsnmp_subtree_find` 能同時見兩註冊、priority 正確。

---

## 7. 實作順序(交給 writing-plans 展開)

1. **PoC**:單一 iss_build==0 rowStatus 群組,驗 §6 三項風險(priority 併存、subtree 迭代、wire 落點)。
2. in-master:`mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework` + `MODE_IS_GET` iss_build==0 分支。
3. framework subagent:全 iss_build==0 OID 註冊為 GET 服務端 + priority 設定。
4. 還原被 Plan D 註解的 INIT_ENTRY(如有)。
5. build(依 build order:plugin_moxa_snmp → rust → final)。
6. DUT 驗證(§1 成功準則)。
7. ADR-0003 轉 Accepted、ADR-0001/0002 標 Superseded(先問 user)。

## Reference
- Plan C 前送機制:`3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c:3062-3168`(`mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]` / `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss`)
- GET/SET 分派:`ies_auto_mibs.c:3179`(`mox_snmp_handle_entry`,GET 3233 / SET 3318)
- iss_build 判斷:`moxa_snmp_handle_util.c:265`(CheckFromIss)、`:277`(CheckFromUri)
- framework 註冊:`lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c:60`(`netsnmp_register_instance`)
- ADR-0001 / ADR-0002:`~/mds4xgl3/.adr/`
- Plan D 設計:`~/plan-d-B-framework-agentx-subagent-design-2026-07-09.md`

# ADR-0003: iss_build==0 —— SNMP GET 前送 framework AgentX、SET 留 in-master

Status: Proposed
Date: 2026-07-23
Context:
  Plan D(ADR-0001/ADR-0002)把 iss_build==0 的 config MIB 從 snmpd in-master
  遷到 app_moxa_framework AgentX subagent,GET+SET 都交給 framework,並註解
  MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY 讓 framework 獨佔 OID。過程撞到硬邊界:framework 用
  netsnmp_register_instance(逐 OID instance),createAndGo 的多 varbind SET PDU
  被逐欄路由,rowStatus handler 看不到同列其他欄 → 動態 append 表無法原子建列;
  只能在 Rust 逐表「重實作」valid-toggle 語意(ADR-0001),每張表對產品行為驗證,
  成本高且有天花板(真正動態長度的表可能複製不了)。
  觀察:Plan C(iss_build==1)已用「in-master 保留註冊贏 wire、只把 GET 前送到
  另一個 AgentX subagent(ISS)」的模式(mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss),SET 留本地。
  這模式可鏡像到 iss_build==0:GET 前送 framework(快),SET 留 in-master(rowStatus
  原生原子),直接繞過上述邊界,不必在 Rust 重實作。
Decision:
  對全部 iss_build==0 群組採用:
  1. in-master(ies-auto-mibs)保留 MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY 註冊,priority 較高、
     贏 wire:SET 走既有 readCreate_v2 + net-snmp table 多階段(原子建列不變)。
  2. GET:在 mox_snmp_handle_entry 的 MODE_IS_GET 分支,以
     moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri(iss_build==0)為閘門,呼叫新增的
     mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework() 前送到 framework AgentX subagent。
  3. mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework 不用硬寫 probe 表(有別於 Plan C 的
     mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]):因同顆 OID 由 in-master 與 framework 併存註冊,
     直接在該 OID 上迭代 subtree、挑 reginfo->handler 非自身(mox_snmp_handle_entry)
     的 framework 註冊前送。→ 按 flag 通用,不用逐群組手寫 probe。
  4. framework AgentX subagent 註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID,但只服務 GET
     (SET 不會落到它);註冊 priority 低於 in-master。
  5. 刻意採 dual registration(in-master 贏 wire+SET、framework 服務被前送 GET),
     以 priority 分序 —— 取代 ADR-0001/0002「避免 dual registration + 註解 INIT_ENTRY
     交接擁有權」的決策。
  本 ADR supersede ADR-0001 / ADR-0002 的擁有權與 SET 面向;保留 ADR-0002 的資料層
  決策(lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs = 純資料/分類,無 net-snmp),framework subagent 續重用。
Alternatives Considered:
  - Plan D 原案(SET 也搬 framework、Rust 重實作 rowStatus valid-toggle、註解
    INIT_ENTRY 獨佔):撞 per-instance 無法原子建列的天花板,每表重實作+驗證成本高,
    動態長度表可能不可行(ADR-0002 已列為殘留硬邊界)。
  - Plan E 只套用在「刻意留 in-master」的子集、其餘走 Plan D:分工較細但兩套機制並存、
    邊界判斷複雜;user 選擇全 iss_build==0 通用政策以求一致。
  - GET 仍走既有 REST 慢路徑(entry_handle_generate_uri_value_file, ~600ms):
    不符「增快速度」目標。
  - framework 擁有 OID、SET 前送回 in-master:framework 端仍先收到逐欄路由的 SET PDU,
    無法原子重組轉發 → 同撞 rowStatus 邊界,不可行。
Consequences:
  - 刻意 dual registration:in-master 與 framework 必須設不同 priority(in-master 高),
    需驗證 net-snmp 不判 MIB_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION 而是依 priority 併存且可迭代。
  - framework subagent 需註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID 為 GET 服務端(記憶體/啟動成本)。
  - rowStatus SET 留 in-master → 不需在 Rust 逐表重實作/逐表產品驗證(消掉 ADR-0001/0002
    的持續成本與天花板)。

  - 未驗證前為 Proposed:PoC(單一 rowStatus 群組如 trustAccess/mxTrap)通過 priority 併存、
    subtree 迭代 API、wire 落點三項後,轉 Accepted 並將 ADR-0001/0002 標
    Superseded by ADR-0003(動舊 ADR 前先與 user 確認)。
Constraints / Assumptions:
  - iss_build==0 = framework/config 擁有;iss_build==1 = ISS 擁有(不變,Plan C 續行)。
  - framework subagent 用 netsnmp_register_instance(逐 OID instance)。
  - net-snmp 允許同 OID region 多 subtree 依 priority 排序(待 PoC 核實 5.9.3 行為)。
  - SET 正確性依賴 in-master readCreate_uri_set_tableRowStatus_v2 + 多階段 SET。
Related Files / Modules:
  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c
    (mox_snmp_handle_entry:3179 / MODE_IS_GET:3233 / Plan C 前送:3062-3168;
     新增 mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework)
  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/moxa_snmp_handle_util.c:277
    (moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri = iss_build==0 閘門)
  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup.c
    (保留/還原 iss_build==0 群組的 MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY)
  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c:60 (netsnmp_register_instance + priority)
  - buildroot/dl/app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs (全 iss_build==0 GET 服務端註冊)
  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/ (純資料/分類,ADR-0002 保留部分)
  - 設計文件: ~/plan-e-iss0-get-forward-framework-set-in-master-design-2026-07-23.md
Related ADRs:
  - Supersedes(擁有權/SET 面向): ADR-0001, ADR-0002
  - 保留: ADR-0002 的資料層決策(lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 純資料)
  - Plan C 前送機制為本 ADR 的模式來源

**Plan E** (design 2026-07-23, user-approved shape): for **all iss_build==0** MIB groups —
- **SET stays in-master** (net-snmp table reg + `readCreate_v2` multi-stage) → rowStatus atomic create/destroy works natively; **no Rust valid-toggle reimplementation** (dodges ADR-0002's hard boundary).
- **GET forwarded to framework AgentX subagent** (in-process config read, fast) via a new `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework()` in `mox_snmp_handle_entry` MODE_IS_GET branch, gated by `moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri()` (iss_build==0). - Key improvement over Plan C: **no hardcoded probe table** — because in-master + framework **dual-register the same OID**, iterate subtrees at that OID and pick the one whose `reginfo->handler` is NOT self (`mox_snmp_handle_entry`) = the framework registration. - **Dual registration by priority**: in-master priority higher → wins wire (SET + GET intercept); framework serves only forwarded GET. Supersedes ADR-0001/0002's "avoid dual registration + comment out INIT_ENTRY handoff".

Base directory for this skill: /home/moxa/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.1.1/skills/writing-plans

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Remember
- Exact file paths always
- Complete code in every step — if a step changes code, show the code
- Exact commands with expected output
- DRY, YAGNI, TDD, frequent commits

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

關鍵在於 agentx_owned.list 在 Plan C 做了**兩件事**，而 Plan E 只剩一件：

| list 的職責 | Plan C（iss_build==1） | Plan E（iss_build==0） |
|---|---|---|
| **(a) 閘門**：哪些 OID 走 AgentX | ✅ 用它篩 | ⬅ **這件事還在，但有替代** |
| **(b) 機制**：逼 in-master **skip 註冊**，讓 ISS 獨佔一個 probe OID | ✅ 必要（否則 probe 找不到 ISS） | ❌ **不需要** |

**為什麼 (b) 在 Plan E 消失**：Plan C 因為 RW 欄只有 in-master 註冊，得靠 list 把某個 RO OID skip 掉、讓 ISS 獨佔當 probe，才能用 `netsnmp_subtree_find(probe)` 定位 ISS。Plan E 是**同一顆 OID 由 in-master 與 framework 併存註冊**，直接迭代 subtree 挑「handler 不是自己」的那個就找到 framework —— **不用 skip、不用 probe、不用 list**。

好問題，這其實比我前面二選一的框架更深一層。先直接回答你三個問題，並修正一下我前面的框架。

## 1. 顯式 vs 隱式，具體差在哪

閘門問的是「這顆 OID 的 GET 要不要前送？」兩者差在**這個判斷的資料來源**：

| | 資料來源 | 判斷時機 |
|---|---|---|
| **顯式** | `agentx_owned.list` 檔（URI prefix 清單） | in-master init 讀檔建 index，handler 查表 |
| **隱式** | entry 自帶的 `iss_build` flag（+ subagent 有沒有註冊那顆 OID） | 純看 flag + runtime 註冊狀態，無檔 |

## 2. 但真正的軸不是「顯式/隱式」，是「skip 還是 forward」

這是我前面沒講清楚、也是你的直覺對的地方。in-master 對一顆 OID 只有兩種處置，取決於**in-master 要不要為了 SET 保留註冊**：

| 情境 | 機制 | 需要 list 嗎？ | 有 fallback 嗎？ |
|---|---|---|---|
| **RO / SET 不在 in-master** | **skip** 本地註冊，master 原生路由到 subagent（最快最乾淨） | **需要**（list = 安全白名單，確認真有 subagent 服務，否則 skip 掉變 noSuchObject，**無 fallback**） | ❌ |
| **RW / SET 在 in-master** | **dual-register + forward GET**（in-master 贏 wire 處理 SET，GET 轉給 subagent） | **不需要**（找不到 subagent → 回 -1 → fall back 到 REST 慢路徑） | ✅ |

- **Plan C** 其實已經**同時用了兩種**：ifTable RO 欄 → skip（靠 list）；ifAdminStatus 等 RW 欄 → dual-register + probe-forward。
- **Plan E** 的 trustAccess：rowStatus/ipAddress/netmask 是 **RW → forward**（安全，有 fallback）；只有 index `.2.1.1` 是 RO。

**關鍵結論**：`forward`（RW）這條**天生適合隱式**（有 REST 保底，錯了不會壞）；`skip`（RO 獨佔）這條**需要顯式 list**（無 fallback，list 是「確認 subagent 真的服務」的安全閘）。所以最終不會是「純隱式」也不是「純 list」，而是：**list 只留給 skip 的獨佔 OID；forward 一律隱式（靠 iss_build + mode 推導）**。

## 3. 回答你的兩個問題

**Q：過程中會兩式並存嗎？** → **會，而且無法避免**，但不是同一批 OID 用兩種閘門，而是**兩個子系統同時在跑**：
- iss1（Plan C）**已經上線**用 list/skip/probe，Plan E 不動它 → list 繼續為 iss1 服務。
- iss0（Plan E）走新的 dual-register+iterate。

所以 Plan E 期間：**iss1 的 list** ＋ **iss0 的無 list forward** 並存。這是既有 Plan C 已出貨造成的，不是設計選擇。

**Q：「先 iss0 隱式，做完再把 iss1 導入隱式」對嗎？** → 方向對，但要精確化終點：
- iss1 的 **RW 前送**（目前 4 條硬寫 probe 規則）→ 可改成 Plan E 的 dual-register+iterate，**移除硬寫規則**，這是純改善。✅
- iss1 的 **RO skip**（ifTable）→ **不建議也改隱式**：skip 沒有 fallback，list 是它的安全網。硬拿掉 list 會讓「skip 了但 subagent 沒服務」變成靜默 noSuchObject。

→ 所以終點是：**forward 全隱式（iss0+iss1 統一，probe 表退休）；list 縮小到只剩 skip 的獨佔 OID**。agentx_owned.list 不會完全消失，但會瘦身。

---

## 我的建議（給 PoC）

trustAccess 的 rowStatus 表是 **RW → forward** 這條，天生適合隱式且有 fallback。所以 PoC **用隱式（gate = `iss_build==0` + `HANDLER_CAN_SET`/RW，不加 list 條目）** 最乾淨，也直接對齊你要的隱式終點、不製造之後要刪的 list 垃圾。

這跟你剛才選的「顯式」相反——因為你這個追問讓我發現 forward 這條本來就該隱式。你要不要改用隱式做 PoC？

/* Plan E PoC (ADR-0003): forward a trustedIp-table GET to the framework AgentX
 * subagent. Unlike the ISS path (probe OID), here in-master AND framework
 * dual-register the SAME OID, so we locate framework's registration by iterating
 * the subtrees covering this OID and picking the one whose handler is NOT our own
 * (mox_snmp_handle_entry). in-master wins the wire (priority 127 < framework 200);
 * this only runs for GET. Returns 0 if forwarded, -1 if framework not present. */
static const oid mox_trustedip_prefix[] = { 1,3,6,1,4,1,8691,602,1,4,1,2 };
#define MOX_TRUSTEDIP_PREFIX_LEN ((int)(sizeof(mox_trustedip_prefix)/sizeof(oid)))

static int
mox_snmp_entry_is_trustedip(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry)
{
    int i;
    if ( entry->oid_len < MOX_TRUSTEDIP_PREFIX_LEN )
    {
        return 0;
    }
    for ( i = 0; i < MOX_TRUSTEDIP_PREFIX_LEN; i++ )
    {
        if ( (oid) entry->oid_list[i] != mox_trustedip_prefix[i] )
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry,
                                  netsnmp_agent_request_info *reqinfo,
                                  netsnmp_request_info       *request)
{
    netsnmp_subtree      *sub;
    netsnmp_request_info *saved_next;

    /* Walk every subtree registered at this exact OID; dual registration links
     * same-region different-priority subtrees via ->next. Pick the framework one
     * (handler != our own). */
    sub = netsnmp_subtree_find(entry->oid_list, entry->oid_len, NULL, NULL);
    while ( sub != NULL )
    {
        if ( sub->reginfo != NULL && sub->reginfo->handler != NULL &&
             sub->reginfo->handler->access_method != mox_snmp_handle_entry )
        {
            saved_next    = request->next;
            request->next = NULL;
            (void) netsnmp_call_handlers(sub->reginfo, reqinfo, request);
            request->next = saved_next;
            return 0;
        }
        sub = sub->next;
    }
    return -1;                           /* framework subagent not present */
}
```

/* Plan E PoC (ADR-0003): forward a trustedIp-table GET to the framework AgentX
 * subagent. Unlike the ISS path (probe OID), here in-master AND framework
 * dual-register the SAME OID, so we locate framework's registration by iterating
 * the subtrees covering this OID and picking the one whose handler is NOT our own
 * (mox_snmp_handle_entry). in-master wins the wire (priority 127 < framework 200);
 * this only runs for GET. Returns 0 if forwarded, -1 if framework not present. */
static const oid mox_trustedip_prefix[] = { 1,3,6,1,4,1,8691,602,1,4,1,2 };
#define MOX_TRUSTEDIP_PREFIX_LEN ((int)(sizeof(mox_trustedip_prefix)/sizeof(oid)))

static int
mox_snmp_entry_is_trustedip(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry)
{
    int i;
    if ( entry->oid_len < MOX_TRUSTEDIP_PREFIX_LEN )
    {
        return 0;
    }
    for ( i = 0; i < MOX_TRUSTEDIP_PREFIX_LEN; i++ )
    {
        if ( (oid) entry->oid_list[i] != mox_trustedip_prefix[i] )
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static int
mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework(struct ies_auto_mibs_entry *entry,
                                  netsnmp_agent_request_info *reqinfo,
                                  netsnmp_request_info       *request)
{
    netsnmp_subtree      *sub;
    netsnmp_request_info *saved_next;

    /* Walk every subtree registered at this exact OID; dual registration links
     * same-region different-priority subtrees via ->next. Pick the framework one
     * (handler != our own). */
    sub = netsnmp_subtree_find(entry->oid_list, entry->oid_len, NULL, NULL);
    while ( sub != NULL )
    {
        if ( sub->reginfo != NULL && sub->reginfo->handler != NULL &&
             sub->reginfo->handler->access_method != mox_snmp_handle_entry )
        {
            saved_next    = request->next;
            request->next = NULL;
            (void) netsnmp_call_handlers(sub->reginfo, reqinfo, request);
            request->next = saved_next;
            return 0;
        }
        sub = sub->next;
    }
    return -1;                           /* framework subagent not present */
}
```

content.text:
好——你把目標從「PoC 怎麼做」提升到「終局要哪一種，才好維護」。這其實把前面的討論收斂成一個很乾淨的結論。先直接回答你兩個方向的問題，再給終局建議。

## 先回答：兩個方向都不能「乾淨地」完全取代對方 —— 但原因不對稱

### 隱式能完全取代顯式嗎？→ **能，但有一個前提**
隱式唯一卡住的地方是 **skip**（in-master 完全不註冊、讓 master 原生路由到 subagent）。skip **沒有 runtime fallback**：如果 in-master skip 了、但 subagent 其實沒服務 → 靜默 noSuchObject。所以 skip 需要一份「確認真的有人服務」的白名單 = 顯式 list。

**但 forward（dual-register + 前送）有 fallback**（找不到 subagent → 回 REST）。所以：**只要你不用 skip、全部走 forward，隱式就能完全取代顯式**（target 由 `iss_build` 推、加速與否由「subagent 有沒有註冊 + fallback」決定）。卡點一直只有 skip。

### 顯式能完全取代隱式嗎？→ **不能，乾淨地說不能**
因為「這顆 OID 該去 ISS 還是 framework」是**資料的內在屬性**（ISS 內部 MIB vs framework config layer），這正是 `iss_build` 這個 per-entry flag 在 `net_*.h` 記的東西。要把它塞進 list，等於**手動把 2136 筆（1391 iss + 745 framework）的歸屬複製一份到檔案裡**，跟 net_*.h 重複、還要同步 —— 這是維護**倒退**，不是前進。

## 所以終局最一致的選擇：**forward-only + 隱式，退休 agentx_owned.list**

| 決策 | 由誰決定（終局） | 為何 |
|---|---|---|
| 去 ISS 還是 framework | `iss_build` flag（per-entry，內在） | 本來就在 net_*.h，零重複 |
| 要不要加速 | subagent 有沒有註冊（framework=`g_reuse_srcs` / ISS 端） | 一個地方控制，有 fallback 保底 |
| 機制 | **只有 forward 一種**（dual-register + 迭代前送） | 單一 code path，無 skip 分歧 |

**一個機制、決策各有單一來源、無手動重複** —— 這才是你要的「後續維護方便」。而且關鍵洞察是：**forward-only 正好解除了 skip 的 fallback 死結，讓隱式得以完全取代顯式**。你剛好問反了方向，但答案指向同一處：往 forward-only 收斂。

## 要付的代價（誠實說）
1. 目前 ifTable RO 走 **skip**（Plan C，`agentx_owned.list=ifmibdb`）。forward-only 要把它改成 dual-register + 前送 → **動到已出貨的 Plan C 路徑**（能動，但要套同樣的 priority/重複註冊處理）。
2. 純 RO、subagent 獨佔的 OID，會從「master 原生路由」變成「in-master 前送一跳」—— 多一點機器、延遲略增。用**一致性**換**微優化**。你既然以維護為先，這筆划算。

## 對 PoC 的影響：**沒有影響，方向還更對**
trustAccess PoC 本來就是 forward（dual-register + 前送），正是 forward-only 終局的第一塊磚。所以 PoC 照跑，只是終局定調讓「閘門之後怎麼收」有了明確答案：**收成隱式、list 逐步退休**。

要我把這個「forward-only + 隱式終局、list 退休」寫進 ADR-0003（並在 generalization 階段納入 ifTable 從 skip 轉 forward）嗎？這會讓 ADR-0003 的 Decision 更完整；PoC 計畫不用改。

# ADR-0003: iss_build==0 —— SNMP GET 前送 framework AgentX、SET 留 in-master

Status: Proposed
Date: 2026-07-23
Context:
  Plan D(ADR-0001/ADR-0002)把 iss_build==0 的 config MIB 從 snmpd in-master
  遷到 app_moxa_framework AgentX subagent,GET+SET 都交給 framework,並註解
  MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY 讓 framework 獨佔 OID。過程撞到硬邊界:framework 用
  netsnmp_register_instance(逐 OID instance),createAndGo 的多 varbind SET PDU
  被逐欄路由,rowStatus handler 看不到同列其他欄 → 動態 append 表無法原子建列;
  只能在 Rust 逐表「重實作」valid-toggle 語意(ADR-0001),每張表對產品行為驗證,
  成本高且有天花板(真正動態長度的表可能複製不了)。
  觀察:Plan C(iss_build==1)已用「in-master 保留註冊贏 wire、只把 GET 前送到
  另一個 AgentX subagent(ISS)」的模式(mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss),SET 留本地。
  這模式可鏡像到 iss_build==0:GET 前送 framework(快),SET 留 in-master(rowStatus
  原生原子),直接繞過上述邊界,不必在 Rust 重實作。
Decision:
  對全部 iss_build==0 群組採用:
  1. in-master(ies-auto-mibs)保留 MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY 註冊,priority 較高、
     贏 wire:SET 走既有 readCreate_v2 + net-snmp table 多階段(原子建列不變)。
  2. GET:在 mox_snmp_handle_entry 的 MODE_IS_GET 分支,以
     moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri(iss_build==0)為閘門,呼叫新增的
     mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework() 前送到 framework AgentX subagent。
  3. mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework 不用硬寫 probe 表(有別於 Plan C 的
     mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]):因同顆 OID 由 in-master 與 framework 併存註冊,
     直接在該 OID 上迭代 subtree、挑 reginfo->handler 非自身(mox_snmp_handle_entry)
     的 framework 註冊前送。→ 按 flag 通用,不用逐群組手寫 probe。
  4. framework AgentX subagent 註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID,但只服務 GET
     (SET 不會落到它);註冊 priority 低於 in-master。
  5. 刻意採 dual registration(in-master 贏 wire+SET、framework 服務被前送 GET),
     以 priority 分序 —— 取代 ADR-0001/0002「避免 dual registration + 註解 INIT_ENTRY
     交接擁有權」的決策。
  本 ADR supersede ADR-0001 / ADR-0002 的擁有權與 SET 面向;保留 ADR-0002 的資料層
  決策(lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs = 純資料/分類,無 net-snmp),framework subagent 續重用。
Alternatives Considered:
  - Plan D 原案(SET 也搬 framework、Rust 重實作 rowStatus valid-toggle、註解
    INIT_ENTRY 獨佔):撞 per-instance 無法原子建列的天花板,每表重實作+驗證成本高,
    動態長度表可能不可行(ADR-0002 已列為殘留硬邊界)。
  - Plan E 只套用在「刻意留 in-master」的子集、其餘走 Plan D:分工較細但兩套機制並存、
    邊界判斷複雜;user 選擇全 iss_build==0 通用政策以求一致。
  - GET 仍走既有 REST 慢路徑(entry_handle_generate_uri_value_file, ~600ms):
    不符「增快速度」目標。
  - framework 擁有 OID、SET 前送回 in-master:framework 端仍先收到逐欄路由的 SET PDU,
    無法原子重組轉發 → 同撞 rowStatus 邊界,不可行。
Consequences:
  - 刻意 dual registration:in-master 與 framework 必須設不同 priority(in-master 高),
    需驗證 net-snmp 不判 MIB_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION 而是依 priority 併存且可迭代。
  - framework subagent 需註冊全部 iss_build==0 OID 為 GET 服務端(記憶體/啟動成本)。
  - rowStatus SET 留 in-master → 不需在 Rust 逐表重實作/逐表產品驗證(消掉 ADR-0001/0002
    的持續成本與天花板)。
  - 若 Plan D 分支已註解某些群組 INIT_ENTRY,Plan E 需還原(in-master 重新持有 SET)。
  - 未驗證前為 Proposed:PoC(單一 rowStatus 群組如 trustAccess/mxTrap)通過 priority 併存、
    subtree 迭代 API、wire 落點三項後,轉 Accepted 並將 ADR-0001/0002 標
    Superseded by ADR-0003(動舊 ADR 前先與 user 確認)。
Constraints / Assumptions:
  - iss_build==0 = framework/config 擁有;iss_build==1 = ISS 擁有(不變,Plan C 續行)。
  - framework subagent 用 netsnmp_register_instance(逐 OID instance)。
  - net-snmp 允許同 OID region 多 subtree 依 priority 排序(待 PoC 核實 5.9.3 行為)。
  - SET 正確性依賴 in-master readCreate_uri_set_tableRowStatus_v2 + 多階段 SET。
Related Files / Modules:
  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c
    (mox_snmp_handle_entry:3179 / MODE_IS_GET:3233 / Plan C 前送:3062-3168;
     新增 mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework)
  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/moxa_snmp_handle_util.c:277
    (moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri = iss_build==0 閘門)
  - buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup.c
    (保留/還原 iss_build==0 群組的 MOX_SNMP_INIT_ENTRY)
  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_snmp_agentx/src/agentx.c:60 (netsnmp_register_instance + priority)
  - buildroot/dl/app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs (全 iss_build==0 GET 服務端註冊)
  - buildroot/dl/lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/ (純資料/分類,ADR-0002 保留部分)
  - 設計文件: ~/plan-e-iss0-get-forward-framework-set-in-master-design-2026-07-23.md
Related ADRs:
  - Supersedes(擁有權/SET 面向): ADR-0001, ADR-0002
  - 保留: ADR-0002 的資料層決策(lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs 純資料)
  - Plan C 前送機制為本 ADR 的模式來源

  原生原子),直接繞過上述邊界,不必在 Rust 重實作。

---
name: project_plan_e_iss0_get_forward
description: "Plan E — iss_build==0 SNMP GET forwards to framework AgentX, SET stays in-master; supersedes Plan D ownership/SET (ADR-0003 Proposed)"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: fdcca453-327c-40cb-8faa-a4fb19df1a7f
---

**Plan E** (design 2026-07-23, user-approved shape): for **all iss_build==0** MIB groups —
- **SET stays in-master** (net-snmp table reg + `readCreate_v2` multi-stage) → rowStatus atomic create/destroy works natively; **no Rust valid-toggle reimplementation** (dodges ADR-0002's hard boundary).
- **GET forwarded to framework AgentX subagent** (in-process config read, fast) via a new `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_framework()` in `mox_snmp_handle_entry` MODE_IS_GET branch, gated by `moxaSnmpHandle_UtilMibEntryCheckFromUri()` (iss_build==0). Mirrors Plan C's `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss` (`ies_auto_mibs.c:3062-3168`).
- Key improvement over Plan C: **no hardcoded probe table** — because in-master + framework **dual-register the same OID**, iterate subtrees at that OID and pick the one whose `reginfo->handler` is NOT self (`mox_snmp_handle_entry`) = the framework registration. Base directory for this skill: /home/moxa/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.1.1/skills/subagent-driven-development

# Subagent-Driven Development

Execute plan by dispatching a fresh implementer subagent per task, a task review (spec compliance + code quality) after each, and a broad whole-branch review at the end.

**Why subagents:** You delegate tasks to specialized agents with isolated context. By precisely crafting their instructions and context, you ensure they stay focused and succeed at their task. They should never inherit your session's context or history — you construct exactly what they need. This also preserves your own context for coordination work.

**Core principle:** Fresh subagent per task + task review (spec + quality) + broad final review = high quality, fast iteration

**Narration:** between tool calls, narrate at most one short line — the
ledger and the tool results carry the record.

**Continuous execution:** Do not pause to check in with your human partner between tasks. Execute all tasks from the plan without stopping. The only reasons to stop are: BLOCKED status you cannot resolve, ambiguity that genuinely prevents progress, or all tasks complete. "Should I continue?" prompts and progress summaries waste their time — they asked you to execute the plan, so execute it.

## When to Use

```dot
digraph when_to_use {
    "Have implementation plan?" [shape=diamond];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" [shape=diamond];
    "Stay in this session?" [shape=diamond];
    "subagent-driven-development" [shape=box];
    "executing-plans" [shape=box];
    "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [shape=box];

    "Have implementation plan?" -> "Tasks mostly independent?" [label="yes"];
    "Have implementation plan?" -> "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [label="no"];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" -> "Stay in this session?" [label="yes"];
    "Tasks mostly independent?" -> "Manual execution or brainstorm first" [label="no - tightly coupled"];
    "Stay in this session?" -> "subagent-driven-development" [label="yes"];
    "Stay in this session?" -> "executing-plans" [label="no - parallel session"];
}
```

**vs. Executing Plans (parallel session):**
- Same session (no context switch)
- Fresh subagent per task (no context pollution)
- Review after each task (spec compliance + code quality), broad review at the end
- Faster iteration (no human-in-loop between tasks)

## The Process

```dot
digraph process {
    rankdir=TB;

    subgraph cluster_per_task {
        label="Per Task";
        "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];

        "Implementer subagent implements, tests, commits, self-reviews" [shape=box];
        "Write diff file, dispatch task reviewer subagent (./task-reviewer-prompt.md)" [shape=box];
        "Task reviewer reports spec ✅ and quality approved?" [shape=diamond];
        "Dispatch fix subagent for Critical/Important findings" [shape=box];
        "Mark task complete in todo list and progress ledger" [shape=box];
    }

    "Read plan, note context and global constraints, create todos" [shape=box];
    "More tasks remain?" [shape=diamond];
    "Dispatch final code reviewer subagent (../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md)" [shape=box];
    "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch" [shape=box style=filled fillcolor=lightgreen];

    "Read plan, note context and global constraints, create todos" -> "Dispatch implementer subagent (./implementer-prompt.md)";

    "Implementer subagent implements, tests, commits, self-reviews" -> "Write diff file, dispatch task reviewer subagent (./task-reviewer-prompt.md)";

    "Dispatch fix subagent for Critical/Important findings" -> "Write diff file, dispatch task reviewer subagent (./task-reviewer-prompt.md)" [label="re-review"];
    "Task reviewer reports spec ✅ and quality approved?" -> "Mark task complete in todo list and progress ledger" [label="yes"];
    "Mark task complete in todo list and progress ledger" -> "More tasks remain?";
